description: Use when an agent researches drugs, diseases or biotech sponsors, or watches trial readouts. Input: condition, intervention (drug), sponsor or q (one or more), optional status, phase, limit, mode=catalysts with days (primary completion within N days, default 90). Output: JSON studies (NCT id, title, phases, status, enrollment, key dates, sponsor, conditions, interventions, countries, link). Example: ?condition=obesity&intervention=semaglutide&phase=3 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

intervention.description: Drug, device or other intervention (alias drug)

mode.description: search (default, newest updates first) or catalysts (primary completion due soon, soonest first)

status.description: Comma list: recruiting, not_yet_recruiting, active, enrolling_by_invitation, completed, terminated, suspended, withdrawn

name: clinical_trials
title: Clinical trials search and readout catalysts (ClinicalTrials.gov): phase, status, enrollment, dates, sponsor
